Solid understanding of relational databases, schema design, data persistence, and safe database migrations. Strong testing mindset with experience implementing contract, integration, unit, and/or end-to-end tests. Experience developing asynchronous, queue-based, or event-driven systems and background workers. Understanding of reliability engineering principles, including idempotency, retries, replayability, deduplication, observability, and failure-mode analysis. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to design systems that remain reliable outside of ideal or “happy path” scenarios.
